"'''Blue Six'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was killed during the [[Second battle of Valahari]].<ref name="TCW10" />
